_doc: DEWY receipt for 2026-09-03: the pre-render legibility gate (pull not push, verdict first, show don't tell). See ADR-075, witness stub _STATE/witness/2026-09-03.jsonl (14:29:34), corpus pre-registration _STATE/2026-09-03-gone-in-30s-preregistration.md.

receipts.sharp_question: Why did three well-built counterpart artifacts fail the same reader in the same way, and what stops the fourth?

dewy_vector.D: Adopt ADR-075: a fixed verdict-first grammar plus a two-layer cold-reader eval (mechanical scripts/cold_reader_gate.py + a counterpart-gauntlet facet) as a blocking pre-publish gate on every counterpart surface. Depth is pulled by the reader, never pushed by the author. The lesson moves from per-counterpart memory (instance) to a wired class-level gate.
dewy_vector.E: Ahmed Elsamadisi (calibration source, Sep 3), Jeben re Harry Wilson (Apr 21), Robin (Aug); the forge, PREP renderer, atlas renderer, NFTT engine, counterpart-gauntlet; the memory index (gains a mechanism axis); the author, whose blindspot the gate compensates.
dewy_vector.W: YEARS / constitutional rendering rule. Revisit if the acceptance test (re-rendered Saul page, Ahmed reads it in under two minutes) fails, or the pre-registered corpus test returns H0 after the throttled transcripts are re-read, or the gate over-fits (fails pages counterparts consumed with ease).
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN on the mechanism: three independent counterparts named it verbatim from outside, and the author's own Apr 21 line ('how deep can you go in 30 seconds?') predates all three. YELLOW on thresholds: R1 to R7 are a first calibration on three pages. Falsifier: Ahmed cannot act on the verdict-first Saul re-render inside two minutes, or the corpus hit rate lands below 0.25 on the full 125.

evidence.quote: your delivery mechanisms are just not great
nobody wants depth front. You want depth once you know, like you have the ability to know how to scan it because you built it.
if it takes the system like a day to create it, it should take me an hour to consume it
you are not a person that walks around ready to receive this type of information, even though I think it's pretty critical for you
many executives are like give me the 30 second version. It's like how deep can you go in 30 seconds?
we obviously didn't recognize the shape of the persona demand and bank that pattern as likely for other generalized users (as a best practice)

misses_kept: Ex-ante 2026-08-26 filed 30% that Ahmed would reply without repeating the objection; he repeated it Sep 2. Scored wrong, kept.
Pre-call bundle built Sep 3 morning (atlas with 19 cards on the front door) repeated the push-first error while the diagnosis was already in hand.

Interim corpus read (35 of 125): hits cluster on show-don't-tell ('I need a little demo'), not density; three counterparts pulled toward depth. The gate therefore governs order and disclosure, not total depth.
